proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: with the pointwise description of quotient sheaves standing, injectivity of U -> U' x U'/R' U/R follows because two sections mapping equal agree after f, and after refining T along a tau-covering an R-equivalence r between them maps to r' in R' with s'(r') = t'(r'), hence r' = e'(f(a)); cartesianity forces r = e(a), so a = b; surjectivity follows by refining T twice so that a lifting pair (a', b) with a relation r' in R' is present, pulling r' back along the cartesian square to r in R, and reading off the section t(r) of U mapping to (a', class of b) (source lines 4156-4185)
